name: track_package
description: Register a tracking number and return its current tracking status.

tracking_number.description: The tracking number to look up.

carrier.description: Optional. The carrier name (for example "Yanwen") to use for this package. Supply it only when 17track detected the wrong carrier; the tool then overrides the carrier. After an override, 17track re-parses the package for up to an hour, so the result contains the newly set carrier name and a note instead of fresh tracking details; do not call the tool again for this number until then.
